subject.title: feat: add opt-in telemetry for native chat lifecycle

question: After bounded orphan cleanup and current-head proof, should native tray chat lifecycle telemetry become a supported OpenTelemetry contract?
rationale: The repair is mechanical, but adding and maintaining the exported chat signal catalog is a lasting product and diagnostics commitment that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept After Cleanup
options.body: Land the telemetry contract after bounded cleanup, full validation, and current-head collector proof.

options.title: Narrow To Lifecycle Fix
options.body: Retain only the exact-run ownership correction and defer exported chat telemetry to a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Defer Telemetry
options.body: Pause the feature until native and gateway trace propagation can be designed together.

recommendation.title: Accept After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Land the telemetry contract after bounded cleanup, full validation, and current-head collector proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the most detailed current review of the lifecycle and telemetry contract.
